The kit's packer checks scored episodes, frames and objects against the public reference, recomputes the Track 2 metrics locally and compares them with the evaluator's metrics JSON, and carries evaluator and checkpoint hashes into the submission CSV.
Each Track 2 tier has four Kaggle metric competitions, the same CSV is used for all four, and the uploader validates the CSV and sends it to all four.
The official sample submission CSV has 900 contiguous frames (0 to 899) for e000011, while the batch 1 smoke of ep11 on mf4090 reports 901 frames.
